generator_seed: Independent secrets.randbits(128), retained only in sealed_truth mapping
opaque_ids: uuid4 independent of shape/seed; public writing order sorted by opaque ID
physics: Existing nonlinear scalar-TM disk-pulse VIE, k=2pi, complex128,576 independent real material cells

material.alpha: 8x8 area average per cell from a192x192 binary geometric raster; truth support alpha>=.5

objective.whitened_equivalent: a*.5*||R/sigma||^2+R_historical where a=sigma^2/||Y||^2; alternatively divide entire objective by a and use prior R_historical/a

metrics.shape: 256-bin reconstruction-only Otsu IoU against private alpha>=.5 support
extra_descriptive: fixed known amplitude midpoint IoU at m>6.1
support centroid distance in physical coordinates

truth_policy: Generator only until every frozen method/case prediction disposition is sealed and parent explicitly authorizes score; no truth/alpha/mask/cleanY/parameters/label in public NPZ
publication_policy: Private mapping/seeds/truth not included in solver payload; release only after scoring closure authorization
generation: Write once; failure receipt preserved; never regenerate to improve result or GT self-IoU
algorithm_freeze_reason: Parent has not frozen methods/budgets; do not generate
